title: Missing Tenant Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) on Invoice Deletion
pr_title: feat: add invoice deletion handler for dashboard
summary: AI generated endpoint allows any authenticated caller to delete any invoice regardless of organizational tenancy boundary.
impact: Exploitable IDOR vulnerability (OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization). An attacker with an org_beta account can wipe all invoices and financial audit logs of enterprise customers in org_alpha.
root_cause: The handler obtains `invoice` by `invoice_id`, checks for existence, but immediately executes `del INVOICES_DB[invoice_id]` without validating `invoice.org_id == current_user.org_id`.
proposed_fix_summary: Add strict multi-tenant ownership guard: raise 403 Forbidden if `invoice.org_id != current_user.org_id`.
